from pocket_coffea.processor.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    def postprocess_objects(self, variation):
        """Object preselection: create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        objects = super().postprocess_objects(variation)
        
        muons = objects["Muon"]

        objects["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]

        """Object counting: store the number of selected muons per event"""
        objects = super().count_objects(variation)

from pocket_coffea.processor.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    def postprocess_objects(self, variation):
        """Object preselection: create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        objects = super().postprocess_objects(variation)
        
        muons = objects["Muon"]
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        objects["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]
        
        return objects
    
    def count_objects(self, variation):
        """Object counting: store the number of selected muons per event"""
        objects = super().count_objects(variation)
        
        if "MuonGood" in objects:
            objects["n_muons"] = ak.num(objects["MuonGood"])
        
        return objects
